items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Spent some time with my two grandchildren who were -- the boy, Tom, is going to be 19 in March

ctx.x: Spent some time with my two grandchildren who were -- the boy, Tom, is going to be 19 in March, and Alexandra is 17 and their mother, our daughter, is a bluegrass fiddle player who has had some success in Nashville, working as

a section musician. And my grandson now who has gone through all the phases of pop, is now gone back to what he was really -- his first environment, which was bluegrass, and he's playing acoustical guitar and singing. And I heard him a couple of weeks ago, singing in a group with his mother involved, which I got a big kick out of.
